major_cooldowns.name: Thunder Focus Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown, spending the empower on Renewing Mist for the Haste buff or on Rising Sun Kick to cut its cooldown, and hold one of the two Master of Harmony charges for the next damage event.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 116680 is the cast id, seen in 5/5 sampled parses; the same id also shows as a short self aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it into heavy group damage and only press it again to summon the Celestials early when you will not lose casts to the cooldown acceleration.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send her ahead of the damage and chain Enveloping Mist on different allies, then follow with Vivify to cash in Invigorating Mists.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Gift of the Celestials halves this to 60s at half duration; 120s is the table's base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press him before a damage window and stay in melee, weaving instant Enveloping Mist on injured allies while stacking Teachings of the Monastery before each Blackout Kick.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Gift of the Celestials halves this to 60s at half duration; 120s is the table's base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Life Cocoon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it on an ally taking sustained heavy damage or already low, where the absorb is worth the most, and use it to solo soak.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Chrysalis shortens this to 75s; 120s is the table's base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Revival
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it for a raid-wide spike where the instant heal and the mass dispel both land, remembering it heals first and dispels second.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Uplifted Spirits shortens this to 150s; 180s is the table's base cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Restoral
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take it over Revival when a raid-wide Magic dispel would be dangerous and press it for the same emergency spikes.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a big hit lands on you to pad your health pool and blunt the damage.
defensives.id_note: 115203 is the cast id; 120954 shares the name and is the self aura.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for burst damage on you, since it cuts the biggest hits the hardest.
defensives.id_note: 122278 and 175395 share this name and neither was pressed in the sampled parses; 122278 matches the 10s duration tooltip, 175395 lists a 90s cooldown.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into magic damage aimed at you and let it send the effect back.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Zen Meditation
defensives.usage_rule: Channel it through a heavy incoming hit when you have nothing you must cast.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Top yourself off with it when you are the one taking chip damage.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Enveloping Mist on every Strength of the Black Ox
rules.action: Fire the proc off with Enveloping Mist on an ally who is taking damage or about to.

rules.description: Drink Mana Tea before stacks cap
rules.action: Chug it in downtime once your stacks are near the cap so no mana you spend is wasted.

rules.description: Enveloping Mist over Vivify inside Yu'lon
rules.action: Chain Enveloping Mist on different allies in her window, then cash them in with Vivify.

rules.description: Tiger Palm before each Blackout Kick
rules.action: Land a Tiger Palm first so Teachings of the Monastery adds hits and reset chances.

rules.description: Spinning Crane Kick on stacked packs
rules.action: Swap your melee filler to Spinning Crane Kick once the pack is stacked up.

source_summary: Mistweaver runs on short cooldowns and procs rather than a fixed rotation: Thunder Focus Tea is pressed constantly to feed Heart of the Jade Serpent cooldown acceleration, while Invoke Yu'lon or Invoke Chi-Ji, Celestial Conduit, Revival and Life Cocoon cover the planned damage. Yu'lon windows are spent chaining Enveloping Mist into Vivify for Invigorating Mists, and Chi-Ji windows are spent in melee turning Blackout Kick and Rising Sun Kick into Gust of Mists healing. Mana Tea stacks and Strength of the Black Ox and Spiritfont procs are held for real damage events and never allowed to cap.
